name: TC-UM-052: Dating Mode options show 'Active'/'Inactive', not 'Dating Mode Active'/'Dating Mode Inactive'

statusDetails.message:
AssertionError: Option 'Dating Mode Active' is incorrectly prefixed with 'Dating Mode'. Labels should be 'Active' and 'Inactive' only — matching the Status filter style.
assert not True
 +  where True = <built-in method startswith of str object at 0x000002A7AE7E89B0>('dating mode ')
 +    where <built-in method startswith of str object at 0x000002A7AE7E89B0> = 'dating mode active'.startswith
 +      where 'dating mode active' = <built-in method lower of str object at 0x000002A7AE8287F0>()
 +        where <built-in method lower of str object at 0x000002A7AE8287F0> = 'Dating Mode Active'.lower
 +          where 'Dating Mode Active' = <built-in method strip of str object at 0x000002A7AE8287F0>()
 +            where <built-in method strip of str object at 0x000002A7AE8287F0> = 'Dating Mode Active'.strip
statusDetails.trace:
